title: Two dead, two hospitalized in California helicopter crash
summary: A medical helicopter crashed off Catalina Island near Los Angeles, California, killing two people and hospitalizing two others. One person remains missing following the incident. The exact cause of the crash is under investigation.
title_hi: कैलिफोर्निया में हेलीकॉप्टर दुर्घटना में दो की मौत, दो घायल
